title: A user without App Settings cannot reach the staff list or staff window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role made for this test, role A, with 'Settings → App Settings' off, so a person on it has no Staff access.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on role A, who can sign in.
  • Note the address of the staff list (Settings, Staff) as an Admin sees it, so you can type it later.
custom_steps:
1. Sign out.
  2. Sign in as staff member A.
  3. Open the Settings menu.
  4. Type the staff list address in the browser's address bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • You are signed out.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A is signed in.

Step 3:

  • The Settings menu, where it shows, does not offer Staff.

Step 4:

  • The staff list does not open, as today.
  • No Technician column, notice or staff window shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S1-N2: “If the user does not have the 'Settings → App Settings' setting, they cannot open the staff list or the staff window, as today.”
  • S4-N1: “If the user does not have the 'Settings → App Settings' setting, they cannot open the staff list, as today, and never see the notice.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Changing a staff member's Technician toggle, and seeing the staff list with its Technician column and notice, are governed by 'Settings → App Settings', the existing permission for Staff.”
